policies.title: Papua New Guinea: current named ordinary-passport tourist Visa on Arrival cohort
policies.summary: ICA’s current Visa on Arrival schedule expressly makes these nationalities eligible; ICA’s visitor guidance confirms the holiday, sightseeing, social, recreational, friends-and-family visitor purpose.
conditions: The live schedule states that VOA is currently accessible to citizens of the named countries. The schedule expressly includes ordinary passports for the United Arab Emirates; Indonesia, Israel and Japan are stated to cover all passport types.
The Visitor Visa page limits this candidate to holiday, sightseeing, social or recreational visits and visits to friends or family; work and non-visitor categories are excluded.

The Visitor Visa page says that, in most circumstances, a visitor visa is single-entry for 60 days. This candidate does not generalize a duration, port, fee, entry count, medical, character, funds, return-travel, or admission condition beyond that source scope.

ICA provides an electronic application option to VOA-eligible travellers, but the directly available arrival route controls this normalized baseline. The PNG Digital Arrival Card is an online arrival declaration, not an ETA or visa.

The remaining non-VOA route is not generalized. The Visitor Visa page directs people outside VOA eligibility to paper filing, while the 2025 handbook and eVisa catalogue indicate online visitor options. Only the named direct eVisa cohorts below are normalized; the rest remain unresolved.

policies.title: Papua New Guinea: current named ordinary-passport Easy Visitor eVisa cohorts
policies.summary: ICA’s live eVisa visitor catalogue names these passports for Easy Visitor Permits and states that applications are lodged online. This candidate records the electronic pre-travel route only where the live catalogue expressly names the passport.
conditions: The ICA-linked eVisa portal labels both 30-day and 60-day Easy Visitor Permits as visitor visas for holidays, sightseeing, social or recreational visits, and visits to relatives and friends.

Both records show an “Eligible Passports” list and state that applications are lodged online (the 30-day permit says online only). The portal is an actual ICA eVisa application flow, not merely a branded information portal.
This policy excludes the 18 passports in ICA’s current direct Visa on Arrival schedule even where the eVisa catalogue also lists them; the available arrival route controls their normalized baseline.

The 60-day catalogue text refers to a Visa on Arrival schedule but its embedded list differs from ICA’s current public schedule. For this policy, that discrepancy is not used to infer any VOA route; it is used only as direct evidence of the named electronic permit.
This policy does not infer eligibility from omissions. All other foreign ordinary-passport pairs remain unresolved pending a current official reconciliation of paper and electronic visitor filing.
